# Findings

Every disagreement the checks have found, how it was ruled, and where it stands. The same list, with the parts each affects, is on the [Trust page](../index.md#ledger).

## Bugs found in virgil

| | Part | Finding | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <span id="F1">F1</span> | `models.ModulatedGaussianRim` | ModulatedGaussianRim modulation azimuth is in-plane, not on-sky | fixed [virgil#134](https://github.com/benjaminpope/virgil/pull/134) |
| <span id="F2">F2</span> | `models.GaussianArc` | GaussianArc truncated its arc-length weight at ±3.5σ | fixed [virgil#134](https://github.com/benjaminpope/virgil/pull/134) |
| <span id="F3">F3</span> | `oidata.OIData` | OIData.uv_grid documented as automatic but set only for AMIGO records | fixed [virgil#134](https://github.com/benjaminpope/virgil/pull/134) |
| <span id="F5">F5</span> | `inference.laplace_cov` | laplace_cov failed with array-valued parameters | fixed [virgil#135](https://github.com/benjaminpope/virgil/pull/135) |
| <span id="F6">F6</span> | `fitting.fit` | fit started at an exact zero-residual optimum reported non-convergence | fixed [virgil#144](https://github.com/benjaminpope/virgil/pull/144) |
| <span id="F7">F7</span> | `fitting.fit` | .expand()ed priors switched fit from LM to L-BFGS | fixed [virgil#142](https://github.com/benjaminpope/virgil/pull/142) |
| <span id="F8">F8</span> | `oidata.OIData` | OIData crashed when every closure phase was flagged | fixed [virgil#155](https://github.com/benjaminpope/virgil/pull/155) [virgil#158](https://github.com/benjaminpope/virgil/pull/158) [virgil#160](https://github.com/benjaminpope/virgil/pull/160) |
| <span id="F9">F9</span> | `spectra.Tabulated` | reference_flux returns every Tabulated node, not the documented mean | fixed [virgil#163](https://github.com/benjaminpope/virgil/pull/163) |
| <span id="F10">F10</span> | `oifits.read_oifits`, `oidata.OIData` | OIData rejects OIFITS whose OI_T3 and OI_VIS2 use different INSNAMEs (identical wavelengths) or reversed baselines | fixed [virgil#167](https://github.com/benjaminpope/virgil/pull/167) |
| <span id="F11">F11</span> | `likelihood.whitened_residuals` | chi-squared of correlated (4+ telescope) closure phases jumps where a residual crosses ±π | fixed [virgil#174](https://github.com/benjaminpope/virgil/pull/174) |
| <span id="F12">F12</span> | `imaging.clean` | imaging.clean returns NaN on even grids without a base scene (near-zero \|J e_p\| at the off-centre seed; exposed by virgil#174) | fixed [virgil#190](https://github.com/benjaminpope/virgil/pull/190) |
| <span id="F13">F13</span> | `oidata.OIData` | OIData groups closure-phase frames by MJD alone; OIFITS v1 snapshots told apart by TIME are merged into one frame | fixed [virgil#203](https://github.com/benjaminpope/virgil/pull/203) |
| <span id="F14">F14</span> | `orbits.total_mass`, `orbits.distance_pc` | orbits.total_mass and distance_pc use a³/P² with P in Julian years, 3.8e-5 from Kepler's third law with the IAU nominal GM_sun and au | fixed [virgil#229](https://github.com/benjaminpope/virgil/pull/229) |
| <span id="F15">F15</span> | `orbits.ThieleInnesOrbit` | ThieleInnesOrbit.to_kepler returns Omega = 180.0 for a node at 180°, outside its documented [0, 180) | fixed [virgil#229](https://github.com/benjaminpope/virgil/pull/229) |
| <span id="F16">F16</span> | `orbits.StateVectorOrbit` | StateVectorOrbit.to_kepler loses the inclination of nearly face-on orbits (0.01° returns 0.0106°), so positions drift by up to 2e-8 of a | fixed [virgil#229](https://github.com/benjaminpope/virgil/pull/229) |
| <span id="F17">F17</span> | `limits.chi2ppf` | limits.chi2ppf with df != 1 raises ImportError, needing tensorflow_probability, which virgil does not declare | open |
| <span id="F18">F18</span> | `epochs.marginal_loglike` | marginal_loglike(s_max=...) integrates each scale on a ln s grid that is too coarse where the likelihood falls steeply from a bound, so differences of m between models are wrong by 0.1-0.7 | to-raise |

## Where codes define things differently

| | Part | Finding | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <span id="F4">F4</span> | `models.Image.from_model` | Image.from_model's brightness floor adds ~1e-5 of flux on large fields | documented |
| <span id="D1">D1</span> | `models.ModulatedGaussianRim` | ModulatedGaussianRim blurs in the rim plane (changed by virgil#139) | documented [virgil#139](https://github.com/benjaminpope/virgil/pull/139) |
| <span id="D2">D2</span> | `models.ModulatedGaussianRim`, `external_bridge.pmoired_models` | Modulated rims differ between virgil and PMOIRED (blurred modulated ring vs modulated profile) | documented |
| <span id="D3">D3</span> | `likelihood.whitened_residuals`, `inference.laplace_cov` | PMOIRED treats closure phases as independent; virgil whitens them as a correlated group | documented |
| <span id="D4">D4</span> | `external_bridge.pmoired_models` | PMOIRED reports uncertainties scaled by sqrt(reduced chi-squared) | documented |
| <span id="D5">D5</span> | `likelihood.whitened_residuals`, `external_bridge.candid_bridge` | CANDID's and fouriever's closure-phase residual is the plain phase difference; virgil's is the chord 2 sin(delta/2) (independent closure phases), or sin(delta) plus a periodic penalty (correlated ones, since virgil#174) | documented |
| <span id="D6">D6</span> | `oidata.OIData.cp_noise`, `likelihood.whitened_residuals` | With unequal closure-phase errors in a group, fouriever uses r^T C^+ r and virgil r^T D^-1/2 R^+ D^-1/2 r (different generalised inverses of the singular C) | documented |
| <span id="D7">D7</span> | `limits.absil_limits`, `limits.injection_limits`, `limits.nsigma` | For correlated closure phases fouriever counts every closure phase as a degree of freedom in the Absil and injection significance; virgil counts the independent ones (OIData.n_independent) | documented |
| <span id="D8">D8</span> | `limits.injection_limits` | CANDID's and fouriever's injection limits refit the primary's uniform-disk diameter to the injected data; virgil's hold every parameter but the flux | documented |
| <span id="D9">D9</span> | `imaging.TSV` | eht-imaging's squared TV (stv2) counts only the steps out of the last row and column; virgil's TSV counts the steps across all four edges | documented |

## Problems found in other packages

| | Part | Finding | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <span id="P1">P1</span> | `pmoired` | PMOIRED setupFit(auto=True) gives NaN models on files with few channels | to-raise |
| <span id="P2">P2</span> | `pmoired` | PMOIRED's default ring sampling is not its documented Nr = 100 | to-raise |
| <span id="P3">P3</span> | `pmoired` | PMOIRED's rings stop at ~1e-4 precision beyond 30 samples per baseline | to-raise |
| <span id="P4">P4</span> | `candid` | CANDID's Absil detection limits are ~1 % low against its own criterion (bracketing by factors of 1.4, then linear interpolation) | to-raise |
| <span id="P5">P5</span> | `fouriever` | fouriever's closure-phase residual is not wrapped, so data straddling +-180 deg give a ~2 pi residual at the true parameters | raised [fouriever#26](https://github.com/kammerje/fouriever/issues/26) |
| <span id="P6">P6</span> | `ehtim` | eht-imaging's Obsdata.tlist/bllist return tuples under NumPy 2 when every time group has the same size, so closure phases fail | to-raise |
| <span id="P7">P7</span> | `orbitize` | orbitize! adds the fitted gamma to companion RVs when primary RVs are present, though its docs say companion RVs are relative to the barycentre | to-raise |
| <span id="P8">P8</span> | `fouriever` | fouriever's uvfit.detlim fails under NumPy 2 and SciPy 1.18 (fouriever 0.4.3); its L-BFGS-B objectives return 1-element arrays, and with V² it %-formats a 1-element array | to-raise |

## Definition changes in virgil

| virgil PR | Change | Our response |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [#139](https://github.com/benjaminpope/virgil/pull/139) (T. De Prins) | `ModulatedGaussianRim` blurs the rim with a Gaussian isotropic in the rim's own plane, not on the sky; `fwhm` is now the in-plane FWHM | references follow the documented definition (`sky.in_plane_blur_factor`); the old definition is kept as a negative control; confirmed independently by PMOIRED's blurred-ring profile (1e-9) |
